stem: Which statement best describes a difference between Cassidy in the article “The Broken-Crayon Solution” and Nissen in the selection “Bouncing Around”?

options.label: F
options.text: Cassidy found it easy to sell her product, but Nissen found it difficult.

options.label: G
options.text: Cassidy was not happy with her invention at first, but Nissen was pleased with his at first.

options.label: H
options.text: Cassidy got the idea for her invention at a public event, but Nissen thought of his idea at home.

options.label: J
options.text: Cassidy made her product to avoid waste, but Nissen made his for exercise.
